IMPLEMENTATION PLAN (planning, lease knots-6813)

Root-cause findings at HEAD (1f1fbe7c, v0.17.3):

D1 (post-write error masks successful advance) — two compounding sites:
 a) src/app/state_ops.rs:91 set_state_with_actor_and_options commits the state write, then calls apply_alias_and_enrich_knot; enrich_step_metadata resolves the knot profile (falling back to the repo default workflow when workflow_id is empty) and its UnknownProfile error propagates as Err AFTER the write committed.
 b) src/app/state_fail_ops.rs terminate_lease_and_recover_bound_action loops over ALL knots with a lease_id and calls resolve_profile_for_record(&knot)? per record — an unresolvable profile on any UNRELATED knot aborts the release with 'workflow error: unknown profile <default_wf>/<profile>' after the advance already succeeded. Its trailing apply_alias_and_enrich_knot can fail the same way.

Fix D1: introduce a best-effort enrichment helper (warn on stderr, return un-enriched/aliased KnotView) and use it on the post-write paths (set_state_with_actor_and_options tail, terminate path tail); in the terminate scan loop, skip records whose profile cannot be resolved with a stderr warning instead of ?-propagating. In execute_next (src/write_dispatch/execute/execute_write_ops.rs), downgrade release_bound_lease errors after a successful state write to stderr warnings so exit code reflects the write outcome (expired-lease materialization already recovers stragglers).

D2 (show -j invalid JSON): does NOT reproduce at HEAD — run_show uses serde_json::to_string_pretty end-to-end (identical code in v0.17.1); multiline description, multiline handoff capsules, CR and ESC control chars all produce RFC 8259-valid output (python json.load passes). Likely a stale-binary observation. Action: attempt broader repro during implementation (capsules added via claim flow, verbose/non-verbose, notes); regardless, add the acceptance regression test asserting show -j parses for knots with multiline capsules, locking the invariant.

D3 (generic bound-lease error hides lease id): src/lease_guard.rs:110 — bound_lease is in scope; change message to name it, e.g. "knot has a bound lease '<id>'; rerun with --lease <id>".

Tests (all as Rust integration/unit tests near existing suites):
 T1: store with default workflow whose default profile is unresolvable + unrelated knot with dangling profile; lease-bound claim+next on a healthy knot returns Ok, state advanced one step, lease released, success line printed.
 T2: show -j on knot with multiline description + multiline capsule parses via serde_json::from_str (and exercised through run_show formatting path).
 T3: next without --lease on a bound knot yields error naming the bound lease id.

Risks: best-effort enrichment must remain OFF for read paths where Err is meaningful — scope it to post-write call sites only. make sanity (fmt, lint incl. 500-line/100-col limits, tests, coverage ratchet) gates the merge. Complexity: small-medium, single PR, no child knots needed. Changeset: patch.
